name: CurrentControlSet Autorun Keys Modification
description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate software automatically (mostly, during installation) sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
Legitimate administrator sets up autorun keys for legitimate reason
query: (registry.path:*\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control* AND (registry.path:(*\\Terminal\ Server\\WinStations\\RDP\-Tcp\\InitialProgram* OR *\\Terminal\ Server\\Wds\\rdpwd\\StartupPrograms* OR *\\SecurityProviders\\SecurityProviders* OR *\\SafeBoot\\AlternateShell* OR *\\Print\\Providers* OR *\\Print\\Monitors* OR *\\NetworkProvider\\Order* OR *\\Lsa\\Notification\ Packages* OR *\\Lsa\\Authentication\ Packages* OR *\\BootVerificationProgram\\ImagePath*))) AND (NOT (winlog.event_data.Details:\(Empty\) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe AND registry.path:*\\Print\\Monitors\\CutePDF\ Writer\ Monitor* AND (winlog.event_data.Details:(cpwmon64_v40.dll OR CutePDF\ Writer))) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe AND registry.path:*Print\\Monitors\\Appmon\\Ports\\Microsoft.Office.OneNote_* AND (user.name:(*AUTHORI* OR *AUTORI*))) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\poqexec.exe AND registry.path:*\\NetworkProvider\\Order\\ProviderOrder) OR (process.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\spoolsv.exe AND registry.path:*\\Print\\Monitors\\MONVNC\\Driver AND winlog.event_data.Details:VNCpm.dll)))
